wording.title: Whole-sphere throughput without a polar filter
wording.x_axis: Simulated time per wall time / polar-limited lat-lon

source_origin: figure-pack/ is written by scripts/prepare_figures.py from the saved measurements in data/ (checked against data/manifest.json); no earlier plot was read
uncertainty: none shown and none exists: values are deterministic measured errors or model outputs, not replicate estimates
transformations: relative is plotted unchanged on a log10 x axis that starts at 1 and ends at 2,000
value labels are relative rounded to whole numbers with a thousands separator and an x suffix
steps_per_s is not drawn; it is kept in the source file

encoding.Polar-limited lat-lon: vermillion filled square, the latitude-longitude reference
encoding.Torus, shared patch work: blue open diamond, additional layout estimate
encoding.row guides: light grey horizontal lines for reading only; they are not bars and encode nothing

status: every value is a model output: the paper's performance model applied to 64 CS-3 systems at 15 arcseconds. No hardware run.
alt_text: Dot plot on a log scale of modelled whole-sphere throughput relative to a polar-limited latitude-longitude grid on 64 CS-3 systems at 15 arcseconds. Polar-limited lat-lon is 1x, the torus with patch work counted is 856x, and the torus with shared patch work, an additional layout estimate shown as an open diamond, is 1,263x.

render.svg: 622.5 pt wide, which is 830 CSS px; text converted to paths so it renders identically without DejaVu Sans installed; a colour-bar gradient, where present, is embedded as a raster at 4x CSS density
render.png: 1660 x 830 px, RGB, no alpha, for display at 830 CSS px

checks: no notes: only the title, axis labels, tick labels, row and column names, value labels and the reference-line label
no em dash, en dash, curly quote or unicode minus
every text at least 14 CSS px
every text at least 6 CSS px inside the canvas
no two texts overlap (2 px clearance)
no text over a data marker or data line (2 px clearance)
